scope: Standalone existing house polygon clipping of identical projected triangles; not a CFD or mesh-acceptance check.
finding: Identical triangle self-clipping changes geometry/duplicates vertices in sectors1,2,5,6,7. Avoid self-intersection when common-edge third projected vertices are exactly equal.
